summary:
# Certified closed display of two joined normal sweeps

The isolated milestone is `adeec530260dc6ba305c886d48c97805df334d9b` on parent `4f301c5c6f027c9c7c60cfc6835b3bb08779375d`. The portable patch SHA-256 is `ee7e0194fbccbe0eb330404b47cde12c4779a9b07f363e25b10962b1e48b5e0f`. The patch adds a read-only original sweep accessor and two offset mesh files.

The tessellator uses the proved affine or Möbius station law to map both sides of the removed wall onto the same distinct vertices. Every shared perimeter vertex retains its exact original parameters and indexed station in each source owner. The individual raw axes stay increasing even when the joined map traverses one backward. The mesh emits the ten original analytic outer faces and their windings with no common wall faces.

The sampler evaluates exact UV and displacement stations on the original analytic charts. Directed binary enclosures of rational UV endpoints are clipped to the original domains and used only for cell bound queries. The continuous source cell and the actual rounded triangle vertices fit one exact directed physical box. The squared diameter bounds both directed distances. When requested, original continuous outward normal boxes certify the orientation and angle of the actual represented facets on the entire cells. A separate exact indexed collision, closure, shell and signed-volume pass accepts a single embedded outward shell, with the sphere Euler count.

The planar linear-station control produces 704 triangles and 20 shared vertices. Its certified physical distance is 0.2795084972 length units at requested 0.36. The signed mesh volume equals the exact represented upper minus lower height, times planar area 4, and is approximately 0.88888888888888884.

The curved control independently authors two strips of the parabolic cylinder `z=y^2/64` with a shared coordinate of `x=5/8`. It uses the exact reversed `3/2` Möbius law, different original domains, a different wall axis on the second chart and exact signed displacement `[-1/9,1/9]`. A request of distance 0.36 and facet angle 0.16 rad produces 9,728 triangles, 72 shared perimeter vertices and 62 nonbinary original B station occurrences. It certifies distance 0.1866753301 and facet angle 0.1087304436 rad using 34,098,712 geometry work units. The signed mesh volume is approximately 0.88903297876490373. The independently integrated symmetric sweep volume is approximately 0.8890335436294402. Tests independently evaluate the physical seam points, per-facet analytic barycenters and their outward normals. They check exact indexed parentage and retained source windings.

Atomic controls cover an invalid pair, triangle, work and collision budgets, insufficient distance and angle refinement, cancellation and a valid exact slab that collapses after binary output rounding. Separate positive and negative nonbinary rational endpoint controls check the directed bracket operation. Six historical single-sweep mesh and option digest pairs match exactly. The supported geometry is the existing sealed two-chart join with a complete Cartesian separating wall. The paired grid is tensor-conforming and bounded, so tighter requests can exhaust configured resources.

`focused.log`, `race.log` and `packages.log` contain qualification runs. `legacy.tsv` matches the prior single-sweep output digest record.
